statement: Removing a FAILED or SYNCING replica succeeds through every removal writer: the FAILED-replica tolerance that skips the REMOVING lifecycle write is owned once and honored by the CDC status-update path, so a failed ADD's cleanup REMOVE can never strand an un-removable replica that blocks ledger spread.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Repro chain (fanout-postfix-seamC.log.txt in solve/report/ledger-surplus-drain-stale-actuals-2026-08-22/): ADD of replica_operations-p1-r4 fails voter-ready within 10000ms -> cleanup REMOVE hits 'Replica state transition rejected for replica_operations-p1-r4: removing' (replica-handler-status-methods.js:142 via CDC status update) -> 'Invalid state transition attempted' -> removal fails, r4 stranded, spread never completes, concentration hold stays honestly engaged, provisioning wedges. Matrix gap: REPLICA_STATE_MACHINE_VALID_TRANSITIONS (replica-state-machine-constants.js:20) permits FAILED->[REMOVED] only; no FAILED->REMOVING, no SYNCING->REMOVING. The tolerance shouldSkipReplicaRemovalLifecycleWrite (replica-handler-remove-execution-methods.js) exists in the removal executor but the CDC status-update writer does not consult it - two writers, one tolerance.
